Model a general information assignment as a weight summed over an element's archons. Additivity on disjoint elements is 23.LI.3. SYMMETRY -- equal weight on every archon -- makes the weight CONSTANT, call it alpha; then the assignment is exactly alpha*L(d) (the archon count times the quantum). And the SCALE is the ONLY freedom: every alpha yields I=alpha*L, so the structure is fixed and alpha is a single free constant (its value is SG.4's owed external input). Equal Archon Information is now a REPRESENTATION theorem up to scale, not a postulate. Its payoff meets the warrant condition: for a ball, I(B_r) = alpha*L(B_r) = alpha*|B_r| (23.LI.4) -- the top-down I/alpha recovers the bottom-up count, grounded in the count rather than assumed.
